audit.why: Lane difficulty 7.5/10 with a 53.52% win rate over 1534 games is consistent: Sion is favoured but Purge (W) percent-HP shred punishes his HP identity, so the lane stays skill-expressive.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was scored to Urgot in both layers while every surrounding line (whys[4], spikes[1], mid) argues Sion's Unstoppable Onslaught answers Disdain and out-ranges an immobile champion.
audit.why: Urgot has no dash and no way to escape a 7500-range charge; Fear Beyond Death is a 100s cooldown at rank 1 versus Sion's 140s, but it does not contest Sion's engage in a 1v1. The packet level chart also lists Sion at Level 6.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] flipped to Sion, rating inverted 3/10 -> 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Disdain was written as a flat 14-second cooldown; that is only rank 5. It is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14, so the punish window in lane is longer than the page claims.
audit.why: Concrete cooldown numbers are what make the 'engage only when Disdain is down' rule usable at levels 1-5.
Disdain (16s down to 14s) is correctly identified as the punishable cooldown; Purge is not punishable by cooldown since it reaches 0s at rank 5.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2] titled 'Stack pure HP vs his W' carried a body about channeling Q in the open — the text did not match its own heading.
audit.why: Purge deals percent max HP, so the correct don't is about armour/HP itemisation, not Q channels.
audit.corrected: Body rewritten to address percent-HP damage and Steelcaps.

edits.before: Urgot's E flip is a 14-second cooldown that repositions you into his W leg zone — charged Q to stun him immediately after the flip animation ends, negating the leg window he needs to deal damage.
edits.after: Disdain (E) is a 16s cooldown at rank 1 and drops you into his Purge leg zone — start charging Q as the flip begins so the stun lands the instant he releases you, and the leg cycle he needs never happens.

edits.before: Neither of you has a new major tool — respect his Disdain cooldown and only trade when W-shield is available to absorb the percent-HP opening burst.
edits.after: Neither of you has a new major tool — Disdain is a 15s cooldown here, so count it down and trade only while your 13s W-shield is up for the Purge burst.

edits.before: Bait your charged Q charge with his R fear-execute threat and punish you for wasted CC
edits.after: Bait your Q charge with a Disdain feint and flip you mid-channel so the knockup never fires

edits.before: Channeling Q in the open â€” telegraphed Q is dodged Q, and you just stood still for his full combo.
edits.after: Armour won't answer Purge — it burns percent max HP, so pair HP stacking with Steelcaps and short trades.

notes: Kit flag misfire: urgot Q (Corrosive Charge) carries a 'dash' flag, but Riot's own description says it fires an explosive charge at a target location — it is not a dash. The missingInteractions entry built on that flag ('your R shuts off Urgot's Corrosive Charge') is therefore wrong and was NOT written to the page. Sion Q's listed range of 10000 is also a data artifact and was not used.
